prompt:
Make three changes to `recordkit.py`:
1. `slugify` (near the start of the file): runs of non-alphanumeric characters must become a single hyphen, so `slugify("Hello,  World!!")` returns `"hello-world"` instead of `"hello---world"`. Also add an optional keyword parameter `max_length: int | None = None`; when it is given, cut the slug to at most `max_length` characters and remove any hyphen left at the end of the cut slug.
2. `parse_duration` (in the parsing helpers in the middle of the file): also accept a `d` unit for days (86400 seconds), so `"2d3h"` is 183600, and raise `ValueError` for an empty or whitespace-only string instead of returning 0.
3. `format_bytes` (in the formatting helpers at the end of the file): add a keyword parameter `binary: bool = False`. When it is true, divide by 1024 instead of 1000 and use the units B, KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB, so `format_bytes(1536, binary=True)` is `"1.5 KiB"`. The default output must not change.
Do not change anything else in the file.
